pages.text: Pleroma is made of five fluids, one for each branch of knowledge and one for the world: $(fluid)Quintessence$(), $(fluid)Alkahest$(), $(fluid)Mathesis$(), $(fluid)Panacea$() and $(fluid)Anima Mundi$() (see $(l)The Five Fluids of Pleroma$()). Pour $(thing)1,000 mB$() of each into the $(item)Pleroma Confluence$(); whenever all five are there, 1,000 mB of $(fluid)Pleroma$() appears.

The old word means 'fullness': the totality of everything. Fitting. It accepts the five from any pipe or AE2 on any side, holds up to 16,000 mB of each, and Pleroma can be drained from any side. Its screen (and JEI) shows which are still missing.$(br2)Every branch I ever studied ends in this one tank.
Pleroma carried in a $(item)Containment Cell$(), like every fluid of the mod: fill it at a tank, empty it into one.
